title: download bytes match the uploaded SHA-256
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA Cloud / S3
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated attachment download and Web Crypto SHA-256 comparison
actualResult: The authenticated attachment content endpoint returned HTTP 200 and 131 bytes. The downloaded SHA-256 was 4AB336F3C87CB7AAC1A0741C0196BD71C8BC099D0D5D19E143454F07C97707DD, exactly matching the sanitized local fixture.
assertions: Downloaded SHA-256 exactly matched the precomputed local fixture SHA-256.
Content type and safe filename were preserved.
limitations: The hash assertion covers the deployed S3-backed content path. The active Fiori attachment table did not render the persisted row, so download validation used the same authenticated browser session and standard content endpoint.
